en.t: It was truly a summer with a great deal of rain.

units.source_text: 到箱根以来，没有一个对弈日是晴朗的。

en.t: Since coming to Hakone, not a single day of play had been clear.

units.source_text: 而且晴雨无常，以现在这场雨来说，也是下下停停，停停下下。

en.t: And the weather was unsettled; even this rain now kept falling and stopping, stopping and falling again.

units.source_text: 七段思考黑83时，阳光还投射在八仙花上。

en.t: When the seventh-dan player was considering Black 83, sunlight was still falling on the hydrangeas.

units.source_text: 山上的一片绿意，润泽有光，像是被洗涤过的。

en.t: The sweep of green on the mountain was moist and shining, as if it had been washed clean.

units.source_text: 谁知天空旋即又阴沉下来。

en.t: But before long, the sky unexpectedly darkened again.
